title: Reset privacy permissions for an app or service
summary: Use tccutil to reset macOS privacy permissions. This forces apps to ask for access again, which is useful if an app's permissions are stuck or you want to start fresh.

aliases.text: приложение не спрашивает доступ к камере

steps.explain: Reset the privacy permissions for a specific service (like Camera, Microphone, or Accessibility). The app will ask for permission again next time it tries to use that service.

placeholders.name: SERVICE
placeholders.description: The privacy service to reset, e.g., Camera, Microphone, Accessibility, ScreenCapture.

alternatives.explain: Reset permissions for all privacy services at once.

rollback.explain: There is no direct command to restore previous permission decisions. You must manually re-grant permissions in System Settings > Privacy & Security when the apps prompt you again.

warnings: This will remove all saved permission decisions for the specified service. Apps will prompt for access again.
Resetting 'All' will require you to re-grant permissions for every app that uses privacy services.
